Question B-006-007-007.

Why the correct answer is right: An isotropic radiator has equal radiation in every three-dimensional direction, represented by a sphere.

Per-choice notes:
- sourceIndex 0: "A sphere": Correct. An isotropic radiator has equal radiation in every three-dimensional direction, represented by a sphere.
- sourceIndex 1: "A torus (donut shape)": Those are other pattern shapes; isotropic radiation is equal in every direction.
- sourceIndex 2: "A cardioid": Those are other pattern shapes; isotropic radiation is equal in every direction.
- sourceIndex 3: "A hemisphere": Those are other pattern shapes; isotropic radiation is equal in every direction.
